 HSC and Equivalent Exam Results Published, 52.12% Pass Rate
 by newsdesk 
 30 seconds ago 
 written by newsdesk 
 30 seconds ago 
 0 comments 
 0 views 
 0 Facebook Twitter Email 
 0 
 The results of this year’s Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) and equivalent examinations have been published. This time, the average pass rate across the nine general education boards, madrasa board, and technical education board stands at 52.12 percent.
 The results were officially announced around 10:45 AM on Saturday (October 31) at the International Mother Language Institute in Dhaka.
 Following the publication of results, students can check their scores through their respective educational institutions, education board websites, and via SMS on their mobile phones.
 Students can access their results by visiting the designated education board websites: https://eduboardresults.gov.bd and https://educationboardresults.gov.bd. Results are also available on the websites of the respective education boards.
 To receive results via SMS, students need to go to their message option, type HSC, followed by a space, their roll number, and the exam year, then send it to 16140.
 Meanwhile, applications for result re-scrutiny can be submitted online from November 1 to November 7. Detailed instructions regarding this will be published on the websites of the respective education boards.
